stem.text: A cell of internal resistance $r$ and electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ is connected in series with a resistor of resistance $R$.

stem.alt: Series circuit with a cell and internal resistance in a dashed box, and a resistor R, with current I shown in the left-hand wire; labels E and r on the cell and internal resistance.

stem.text: The resistance $R$ and the e.m.f. $E$ remain fixed. The internal resistance $r$ of the cell changes over time.
Which graph best shows the variation of the current $I$ in the circuit with the internal resistance $r$?

A.alt: Option A graph: I against r, with axes marked 0.

B.alt: Option B graph: I against r, with axes marked 0.

C.alt: Option C graph: I against r, with axes marked 0.

D.alt: Option D graph: I against r, with axes marked 0.
